# 2 Baruch Chapter 42 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**42:1** And-he-answered and-said to-me: These-things also-I-will-explain to-you.

**42:2** As-for-those-who-were-not-righteous and-as-for-those-who-were-not-wicked, but-who-lived-in-the-middle — those-are-they-who-were-troubled-in-their-life-[time], and-they-suffered-tribulation [even-though] they-did-not-serve-the-wicked, and-they-did-not-walk-in-the-paths-of-the-just; and-they-will-be-destroyed.

**42:3** But-those-who-have-walked-in-this-world-without-righteousness and-with-[the]-love-of-falsehood, [and]-have-not-remembered the-law-of-the-Mighty-One — those-will-be-taken-in-the-judgment; and-they-will-not-remember [it then].

**42:4** And-as-for-those-who-have-truly-loved-the-law and-who-have-not-lived-a-double-life with-respect-to-their-wisdom — those-are-they-who-will-receive the-world-which-will-not-pass-away.

**42:5** And-those-who-will-be-separated by-the-law from-the-mixed-[ones] — those will-be-counted with-the-righteous.

**42:6** For-the-law-will-be-the-judge at-that-time; and-it-will-divide-the-just-from-the-unjust, and-[it will put]-the-righteous-on-the-right, and-the-wicked-on-the-left.

**42:7** This-is-therefore the-answer which-I-have-given-to-your-question.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. Chapter 42 is the resolution of the "mixed" people question: the Law itself is the judge. Those in the middle (not clearly righteous or wicked) are destroyed. The Law separates the true righteous from the mixed, placing each side in its proper place. "Double life" (v.4) renders Syriac: not living duplicitously about their wisdom.*
